title: BYOK LLM settings (ADR-011): any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the key. The key itself never goes in this file.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. 'max' is mapped per endpoint (see ASSUMPTIONS A-001).

effort_param.description: Request field that carries the effort value.

paid_tier.description: The owner states that this key is paid-tier or owned by the owner/client (SPEC 13.6). Real client data is only sent when true.
